sharedRules.name: Mine Dog
sharedRules.description:
At close range (5"), an anti-tank Mine Dog may attack a German vehicle by using the Infantry Assault order, then rolling a D6.  Each dog can only be used once.

Roll Result
1	'Damn You Shepski!'	The dog scores an AP hit against the rear armor of the closest friendly Russian armored vehicle within 10" of the dog.

2-4	Casualty: The dog is killed by defensive fire and removed from play.

5	Hit!:  The dog scores an AP4 hit against the target's side armor.

6	Critical Hit!:  The dog scores an AP4 hit against the target's rear armor.

sharedRules.name: Stal! Stal! Stal!
sharedRules.description:
Instead of ordering each vehicle individually, the Russian player may use this special order to activate a D6 worth of light, medium, or lend-lease tanks, instead.

For each order used in the way, roll a D6.  This many units with the keyword 'Stal! Stal! Stal!' may then be activated.  The player may choose to issue this special order multiple times per turn, but each time it must affect different tanks- each vehicle may still only be activated once per turn.

Each tank activated by this order makes two normal moves (which must be directly toward an enemy unit or the opponent's table edge), and then can take a single Area Fire shot (HE or small arms).

Cannot be applied to Heavy Tanks, Assault Guns, or Tank Destroyers.

rules.name: Mortar Pit
rules.description: 3 men and an 82mm mortar in reinforced cover. The cover is lost if the mortar team moves.

rules.name: Sniper Hideout
rules.description: A single sniper in reinforced cover. It can be placed anywhere outside of the opponent’s deployment zone. The cover is lost if the sniper moves.

rules.name: Maxim Machine Gun Dug-out
rules.description: 3 men and a Maxim HMG in reinforced cover. The cover is lost if the MG team moves.

rules.name: Dug-in T-34
rules.description: A single T-34 dug-in up to its turret. The tank cannot move at all in the game, but always counts as an obscured target and gains +1 level to its armour values from all directions. When dug-in, a T34 cannot use the Stal! Stal! Stal! special rule.

rules.name: Dug-in T-34 Platoon
rules.description: Three T-34s dug-in up to their turrets. The tanks cannot move at all in the game, but always counts as an obscured target and gain +1 level to their armour values from all directions. When dug-in, a T34 cannot use the Stal! Stal! Stal! special rule.

rules.name: 'For the Motherland!'
rules.description: At the start of a game, roll a D6 and add this score to the Russian Battlegroup's total morale value for the battle.

rules.name: Counter Bombardment
rules.description:
At the beginning of the game, after both sides have deployed, but before the first turn has been started, roll a D6.

1	No Effect: The bombardment is off target and has no effect.

2-5	Hit: Delays and disorganisation mean that your opponent must take 1 Battle Counter at the beginning of his first turn.

6	Direct Hit: Delays and disorganisation mean that your opponent must take 2 Battle Counters at the beginning of his first turn.

Also, roll a D6 for each enemy unit already deployed. On a 6 the unit is marked as Pinned. If the enemy has no units on the table then this part of the Counter Bombardment has no further effect.

rules.name: Anti-Tank Rifle Team Hideout
rules.description: A small 2 man team armed with an anti-tank rifle, well hidden, in a camouflaged foxhole. These teams had orders to allow the enemy to pass by then attack from the rear. The team can be deployed anywhere outside the attacker’s deployment zone. They are in reinforced cover. If the team moves the cover is lost.

rules.name: Command Bunker
rules.description: A command post in a bunker, providing hardened cover.  The cover is lost if the comand team moves.

rules.name: Artillery Observation Post
rules.description: A Forward Observer Team in reinforced cover.  The cover is lost if the observer team move.

rules.name: Machine Gun Pillbox
rules.description: 3 men and a Maxim MG in hardened cover. The cover is lost if the MG team move.

rules.name: Dug-in T-34
rules.description: A single KV-1E dug-in up to its turret. The tank cannot move at all in the game, but always counts as an obscured target and gains +1 level to its armour values from all directions. When dug-in, a KV-1E does not suffer from the Unreliable special rule.

rules.name: Off-table 76.2mm ZiS-3 Anti-Tank Shot
rules.description: The positions are covered by ZiS-3s, well-camouflaged behind the lines. You may take a single 76.2mm/L53 Aimed Fire – Armour-Piercing shot at an enemy vehicle within 30" of your table edge. The shot will hit on a dice roll of 6, with a penetration value of 4. This requires no orders to use.
